usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and Axonaut records the buyer as a company when “Order Paid” runs “Create Company”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Company” in Axonaut
bestTemplate.why: A paid order puts the customer into Axonaut, ready for invoicing and follow-up.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” fires on edits, so the same customer can be created twice.
